calls.title: Valeria Nunez del Prado and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team assessed various survey providers and research methodologies to ensure a balance of cost and depth for future market insights. Dimensional Research was highlighted as a high-cost option, with significant benefits in detailed reporting, but deemed excessive for simpler surveys. Alternatives like Pollfish were considered for their affordability and targeted approach. Budget discussions included a six-month campaign proposal plus an optional data-led add-on, with a follow-up meeting scheduled for further evaluation. The team emphasized the importance of precise question design, clear data visualization, and collaborative input for effective survey results, while ensuring media outreach targets high-authority publications that are contextually relevant.
calls.keywords: Market Research, Survey Pricing, Data-Driven Campaign, Media Outreach, Domain Rating, Thought Leadership
